nodes.name: Natural resource survey
nodes.summary: Locate and record workable minerals, fuels, water and plant fibers; deposit quality and transport remain untested.

nodes.name: Stone hand tools
nodes.summary: Stone cutting, grinding and drilling tools plus friction or spark ignition candidates bootstrap initial extraction and heat.

nodes.name: Abrasive stones
nodes.summary: Selected stones and powders support rough shaping and early polishing.

nodes.name: Plant fiber
nodes.summary: Plant fibers support cord, cloth, paper and recordkeeping; mineral and charcoal marks are candidate methods.

nodes.name: Fiber cord
nodes.summary: Twisted fibers enable bindings, simple drives and handling fixtures.

nodes.name: Timber structures
nodes.summary: Wood frames, shelters and levers support early equipment.

nodes.name: Clay pottery
nodes.summary: Select and prepare clay, then fire vessels, bricks and furnace pieces; fired vessels also contain samples and process liquids.

nodes.name: Charcoal
nodes.summary: Carbonized wood is a candidate fuel and reducing agent.

nodes.name: Kiln
nodes.summary: A controlled firing chamber for pottery and early ceramics.

nodes.name: Bellows
nodes.summary: Manual air delivery raises combustion intensity.

nodes.name: Water supply
nodes.summary: Collection, settling and conveyance for processing water.

nodes.name: Manual drive
nodes.summary: Human powered cranks, treadles and flywheels for early workshop motion.

nodes.name: Mechanical power
nodes.summary: Water, wind and steam machinery are alternative site-dependent sources of continuous shaft power; steam adds separate pressure and sealing challenges.

nodes.name: Generator
nodes.summary: Convert shaft motion to workshop electricity.

nodes.name: Power distribution
nodes.summary: Conductors, insulation and protection distribute factory electricity.

nodes.name: Regulated power
nodes.summary: Stable electrical supplies at low, high-current or high-voltage tiers serve instrumentation, electrolysis and semiconductor equipment.

nodes.name: Heat treatment
nodes.summary: Controlled heating and cooling, with suitable water or oil quench media, change metal properties.

nodes.name: Furnaces
nodes.summary: Higher temperature chambers for melting, reduction and controlled atmospheres.

nodes.name: Refractories
nodes.summary: Heat resistant linings and crucibles for hot processing.

nodes.name: Mining tools
nodes.summary: Extraction equipment ranges from stone tools to metal drills and lifting gear.

nodes.name: Ore crushing
nodes.summary: Crushers and mills reduce ore for separation.

nodes.name: Mineral separation
nodes.summary: Washing, gravity, magnetic or chemical separation concentrates minerals.

nodes.name: Iron stock
nodes.summary: Iron and steel feed for structures, machines and magnetic cores.

nodes.name: Copper stock
nodes.summary: Copper feed for conductors, coils and circuit metallization.

nodes.name: Aluminum stock
nodes.summary: Aluminum feed for enclosure parts and selected conductors.

nodes.name: Alloy stock
nodes.summary: Prepared alloys for solder, contacts, springs and corrosion resistance.

nodes.name: Rare earth stock
nodes.summary: Separated rare earth compounds or metals for magnet variants.

nodes.name: Magnet stock
nodes.summary: Ferrite, alloy or rare earth magnetic material; routes are alternatives.

nodes.name: Copper wire
nodes.summary: Insulated copper conductor feed for coils and factory wiring.

nodes.name: Wire drawing
nodes.summary: Draw wire through made dies with controlled reduction and lubrication.

nodes.name: Bearing stock
nodes.summary: Plain or rolling bearing components for workshop motion.

nodes.name: Seals
nodes.summary: Gaskets and seals for bellows, fluids, vacuum and machinery.

nodes.name: Workshop surfaces
nodes.summary: Flat stable benches, reference surfaces and vibration control support layout, measurement and fine processing.

nodes.name: Dimensional metrology
nodes.summary: Rules, gauges and comparators measure length, shape and alignment.

nodes.name: Calibration standards
nodes.summary: Traceable internal standards for length, mass, time, temperature and electricity.

nodes.name: Balances
nodes.summary: Measure mass for chemistry, alloying and resource accounting.

nodes.name: Clocks
nodes.summary: Time references support processing, electronics and frequency checks.

nodes.name: Temperature instruments
nodes.summary: Observe and control heat from firing through semiconductor processing.

nodes.name: Pressure instruments
nodes.summary: Measure pressure and vacuum in machines and process equipment.

nodes.name: Electrical instruments
nodes.summary: Measure current, voltage, resistance and selected signal properties.

nodes.name: Optical metrology
nodes.summary: Optical inspection and alignment for machines, lenses and lithography.

nodes.name: Analytical instruments
nodes.summary: Chemical, purity, moisture and particle measurements support clean fabrication; instrument capability and bootstrap routes remain unresolved.

nodes.name: Machine tools
nodes.summary: Lathes, mills, drills, gears and screws produce workshop motion and accurate parts.

nodes.name: Precision machines
nodes.summary: Refined machining, drilling and positioning equipment supports optics, molds and microdevices; laser variants are candidates.

nodes.name: Hard tool materials
nodes.summary: Hardened steel, carbide or ceramic tools for cutting and dies.

nodes.name: Jigs and fixtures
nodes.summary: Hold and align pieces during fabrication and assembly.

nodes.name: Cooling systems
nodes.summary: Water cooling, heat exchangers or refrigeration remove process heat and stabilize temperatures.

nodes.name: Pumps
nodes.summary: Move process liquids, gases and cooling water.

nodes.name: Vacuum systems
nodes.summary: Pumps, chambers and seals establish process vacuum.

nodes.name: Gas handling
nodes.summary: Generate, purify, store and meter controlled process gases.

nodes.name: Pure water
nodes.summary: Water purification includes particle and dissolved-ion removal at successively cleaner tiers.

nodes.name: Distillation
nodes.summary: Separate liquids or produce distilled water with made vessels.

nodes.name: Filtration
nodes.summary: Particle filtration of liquids and air at required cleanliness tiers.

nodes.name: Chemical workshop
nodes.summary: A staged laboratory for synthesis, separation, electrorefining, polishing slurries, lubricants and chemical handling; these are separate bounded recipe candidates.

nodes.name: Acids and bases
nodes.summary: Purified reagents for extraction, cleaning, etching and synthesis.

nodes.name: Solvents
nodes.summary: Purified organic liquids for polymers, cleaning and coatings.

nodes.name: Ventilation
nodes.summary: Air movement and capture for workshop heat, dust and fumes.

nodes.name: Cleanroom
nodes.summary: Controlled particle environment for sensitive fabrication.

nodes.name: Ceramics stock
nodes.summary: Ceramic feed and formed parts support insulating, refractory and substrate uses.

nodes.name: Glass stock
nodes.summary: Glass feed, vessels and optical grades need distinct composition, purity and shaping recipes.

nodes.name: Lens polishing
nodes.summary: Grinding, polishing and inspection equipment for optical surfaces.

nodes.name: Light sources
nodes.summary: Flames, discharge lamps, LEDs or lasers support tiered optical work.

nodes.name: Polymers
nodes.summary: Prepared plastics, elastomers and resins for many device and factory roles.

nodes.name: Adhesives
nodes.summary: Bonding materials for handset assembly and tooling.

nodes.name: Surface cleaning
nodes.summary: Remove contamination before bonding, coating or fabrication.

nodes.name: Coating equipment
nodes.summary: Apply films by wet coating, printing or vacuum deposition.

nodes.name: Molding equipment
nodes.summary: Form polymer, glass or metal parts with prepared molds.

nodes.name: Joining equipment
nodes.summary: Soldering, brazing, welding and bonding tools at needed capability tiers.

nodes.name: Passive components
nodes.summary: Resistors, capacitors and inductors for instrumentation and bootstrap electronics.

nodes.name: Discrete semiconductors
nodes.summary: Diodes and transistors for early electronic control and instruments.

nodes.name: Bootstrap computer
nodes.summary: First computing platform assembled from locally made components, with core/discrete/early IC memory and punched/magnetic/electronic storage as alternatives.

nodes.name: Boot tools
nodes.summary: Hand encoding, assemblers and compilers bootstrap executable programs.

nodes.name: Process control
nodes.summary: Sensors, actuators and control software coordinate factory processes.

nodes.name: Motion control
nodes.summary: Motors and position control for precision machines and patterning.

nodes.name: Design tools
nodes.summary: Locally bootstrapped software for circuits, mechanical design and masks.

nodes.name: Design rules
nodes.summary: Measured fabrication constraints and component behavior guide manufacturable designs.

nodes.name: Silicon feed
nodes.summary: High purity silicon feedstock for chips; purification stages remain unresolved.

nodes.name: Crystal growth
nodes.summary: Grow controlled single crystals for wafers and frequency references.

nodes.name: Wafer preparation
nodes.summary: Slice, polish and clean substrates for microfabrication.

nodes.name: Doping
nodes.summary: Controlled dopant introduction by diffusion or ion implantation are alternative recipes with different machinery requirements.

nodes.name: Diffusion furnace
nodes.summary: Controlled high temperature processing for oxide growth and dopant diffusion.

nodes.name: Lithography
nodes.summary: Pattern device layers; contact, optical and advanced routes require comparison.

nodes.name: Mask making
nodes.summary: Produce patterns for semiconductor or display fabrication.

nodes.name: Photoresist
nodes.summary: Photosensitive patterning chemicals with controlled purity and response.

nodes.name: Etching
nodes.summary: Remove selected materials using wet or plasma chemistry.

nodes.name: Thin film deposition
nodes.summary: Grow or deposit functional layers for chips, displays and optics.

nodes.name: Planarization
nodes.summary: Flatten multilayer surfaces with controlled polishing and inspection.

nodes.name: Integrated circuit fabrication
nodes.summary: A bounded family of wafer process recipes; node and feasible scale are open.

nodes.name: Process test structures
nodes.summary: Test patterns establish electrical behavior, defects and process capability.

nodes.name: Chip packaging
nodes.summary: Dice dies, attach contacts and encapsulate working chips.

nodes.name: Chip test
nodes.summary: Probe and validate dies or packaged chips at usable speed and function.

nodes.name: Test software
nodes.summary: Programs and fixtures for factory and handset verification.

nodes.name: PCB fabrication
nodes.summary: Make patterned multilayer boards and interconnects.

nodes.name: Plating
nodes.summary: Deposit metal layers for contacts, vias and surface finishes.

nodes.name: Assembly equipment
nodes.summary: Place, join and inspect handset parts and circuit assemblies.

nodes.name: Battery materials
nodes.summary: Electrode, electrolyte, separator and current collector feedstocks.

nodes.name: Battery production
nodes.summary: Coat, dry, assemble, fill and form rechargeable cells; stationary energy storage can be an earlier power-platform candidate.

nodes.name: Dry room
nodes.summary: Low moisture environment for battery and sensitive chemical operations.

nodes.name: Display production
nodes.summary: Fabricate and encapsulate display panels; OLED and LCD are candidate variants.

nodes.name: Display chemicals
nodes.summary: Liquid crystal, emissive, conductive and barrier materials by panel route.

nodes.name: Touch production
nodes.summary: Pattern transparent conductors and assemble capacitive touch layers.

nodes.name: Transparent conductors
nodes.summary: Transparent conducting films or alternative fine metal meshes.

nodes.name: Optics production
nodes.summary: Make lenses, coatings and alignment hardware for cameras.

nodes.name: Magnetic parts production
nodes.summary: Make magnets, coils and shaped magnetic structures for audio and actuators.

nodes.name: Standalone handset
nodes.summary: One fully working modern high-end handset that charges from standard external power equipment and connects to today's real-world networks; exact reference target remains open.

nodes.name: Enclosure
nodes.summary: Structural frame and rear housing for the selected handset.

nodes.name: Cover glass
nodes.summary: Durable transparent external display cover.

nodes.name: Display panel
nodes.summary: Modern color screen including addressing electronics; OLED and LCD routes, resolution and driver architecture remain open.

nodes.name: Touch panel
nodes.summary: Capacitive touch layers and their controller electronics, with architecture and fabrication routes unresolved.

nodes.name: Battery cell
nodes.summary: Rechargeable handset cell with chosen chemistry and capacity unresolved.

nodes.name: Battery validation
nodes.summary: Characterize capacity, cycling, protection and abuse response in made containment fixtures.

nodes.name: Main board
nodes.summary: Populated handset circuit board supporting chosen components.

nodes.name: Board passives
nodes.summary: Resistors, capacitors, inductors and selected filters installed in the phone.

nodes.name: Processor
nodes.summary: CPU, GPU and other compute blocks at a defined but unchosen high-end capability.

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.summary: Working memory with capacity and technology to be specified.

nodes.name: Storage
nodes.summary: Nonvolatile handset storage with capacity and endurance to be specified.

nodes.name: Power management
nodes.summary: Voltage conversion, charging and protection circuitry with a compatible standard power input.

nodes.name: Audio system
nodes.summary: Speaker, microphone, audio electronics and acoustic paths.

nodes.name: Speaker
nodes.summary: Miniature sound output transducer and chamber.

nodes.name: Microphone
nodes.summary: Miniature sound input transducer, including MEMS as a candidate route.

nodes.name: Audio codec
nodes.summary: Audio conversion, amplification and control circuitry.

nodes.name: Acoustic test
nodes.summary: Measure sound output, input and distortion with calibration fixtures.

nodes.name: Camera system
nodes.summary: Selected camera modules and offline image pipeline.

nodes.name: Image sensor
nodes.summary: Image sensing chip with pixel count and technology unresolved.

nodes.name: Camera optics
nodes.summary: Lens assembly, filters and housing for a camera module.

nodes.name: Camera actuator
nodes.summary: Autofocus or stabilization mechanism if required by the target.

nodes.name: Camera calibration
nodes.summary: Measure lens, sensor, focus and image pipeline performance.

nodes.name: Sensor system
nodes.summary: Motion, light, proximity and other selected local sensors.

nodes.name: MEMS sensors
nodes.summary: Acceleration, angular rate or pressure devices required by the target.

nodes.name: MEMS fabrication
nodes.summary: Micromechanical fabrication and packaging recipes for selected sensors.

nodes.name: Light sensor
nodes.summary: Photodetection for ambient light and optional proximity functions.

nodes.name: Magnetometer
nodes.summary: Magnetic field sensor for local orientation functions.

nodes.name: Sensor calibration
nodes.summary: Known motion, field, light or pressure references calibrate selected sensors.

nodes.name: RF system
nodes.summary: Required radio subsystem for compatibility with selected current network technologies, bands and operator interfaces.

nodes.name: Modem and baseband
nodes.summary: Standards-compatible radio protocol and signal processing hardware for connection to today's selected real-world networks.

nodes.name: RF front end
nodes.summary: Radio switches, amplifiers, filters and duplexers for selected network bands.

nodes.name: Compound semiconductors
nodes.summary: Non-silicon semiconductor materials and processes for RF or optical variants.

nodes.name: Antennas
nodes.summary: Handset antenna elements for chosen bands and connectivity standards; their interaction with the enclosure requires measurement.

nodes.name: RF test
nodes.summary: Calibrated RF signal generation, reception and spectrum measurements for handset radio hardware and antenna characterization.

nodes.name: Connectors
nodes.summary: Handset external port, internal contacts and flex connections compatible with selected standard charging and data interfaces.

nodes.name: Flexible interconnect
nodes.summary: Flexible circuits and contact assemblies for display and modules.

nodes.name: Thermal system
nodes.summary: Heat spreading and transfer parts for sustained handset operation.

nodes.name: Carbon materials
nodes.summary: Graphite or other carbon feed for heat spreading, battery and tooling variants.

nodes.name: Thermal test
nodes.summary: Measure device temperatures and heat flow under defined loads.

nodes.name: Fasteners
nodes.summary: Screws, clips, seals and bonding features retaining handset parts.

nodes.name: Haptic actuator
nodes.summary: Optional vibration feedback hardware for the selected high-end target.

nodes.name: Firmware build tools
nodes.summary: Compilers, linkers and image-generation tools for the chosen processor.

nodes.name: Firmware
nodes.summary: Installed boot, drivers, hardware initialization and control code, including radio and power-interface firmware.

nodes.name: Operating system
nodes.summary: Local operating environment, scheduling, files, graphics and input services.

nodes.name: Local apps
nodes.summary: Installed applications and local content work offline; network-dependent functions require separately specified compatible services.

nodes.name: Software provisioning
nodes.summary: Transfer boot images, system software and local content into the phone.

nodes.name: Handset validation
nodes.summary: Verify charging, local functions, radio compatibility, performance, integration and selected durability.

nodes.name: Radio power amplifiers
nodes.summary: RF transmit amplifiers with selected bands, output and efficiency; semiconductor route remains open.

nodes.name: Radio filters and duplexers
nodes.summary: Band filters and duplexers, including acoustic-device variants, for selected networks.

nodes.name: SIM and eSIM handling
nodes.summary: Credential interface, secure storage and software for selected SIM or eSIM use; operator credentials are external inputs.

nodes.name: Antenna tuning
nodes.summary: Measure and adjust antenna matching, enclosure interactions and band coverage.

nodes.name: USB interface control
nodes.summary: Port control and data-interface electronics compatible with the chosen standard external equipment.

nodes.name: Charging control
nodes.summary: Charging negotiation, battery control and protection compatible with chosen standard chargers.

nodes.name: Network compatibility test
nodes.summary: Standards and interoperability tests for selected live networks; towers, accounts and network services are external boundaries.

nodes.name: Radio protocol software
nodes.summary: Implemented compatible cellular and selected short-range radio protocols, identity handling and radio control.
